Material Icons (MaterialIcons-Regular.otf)
Copyright Google Inc.
Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
Full license text: http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

Vendored here (third_party/fonts/MaterialIcons-Regular.otf) as a second baked
font for the dbfiller GUI, used to draw a handful of icon glyphs (by their
stable Private Use Area codepoint) inline in buttons and the sidebar - see
ICON_* codepoint constants in src/gui/gui_app.c.
